segments.name: CAR T therapies
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and commercializes next-generation programmed T cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company and the CODM view the Company's operations and manage its business as a single operating and reportable segment, which is the business of developing and commercializing CAR T therapies.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product revenue from sales of AUCATZYL to treat adult relapsed or refractory B-ALL patients, distributed through Cardinal Health in the US and the NHS in the UK, plus license revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: The commercial launch and first sale of AUCATZYL in the United States occurred in January 2025.

changes.text: In 2024 the FDA approved AUCATZYL, and the company began commercial sales in January 2025, moving from development-stage to early commercial-stage.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, the United States Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") approved our biologics license application ("BLA") for the marketing of AUCATZYL (obecabtagene autoleucel, also known as obe-cel) in the United States for the treatment of adult patients (18 years and older) with relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia ("r/r B-ALL").
